reader.reopening: This activity record is not a certificate input or cache-restoration format.

execution.timing_scope: One observed execution; stage timings include their stated calls, total includes evidence retention; not a benchmark.

counting_notes: Compiler counters cover exact BigInt arithmetic, including zero terms, matrix adjoints, dot conjugates, absolute squares and scalar comparisons.
The constructor's small integer phase formulas and table lookups are recorded separately in family.construction.stats.
The fresh reader validates and indexes the saved certificate; it invokes no compiler, inner-product, ring-product or rational-reduction arithmetic.
Reversed overlap queries return the retained conjugate scalar; their detailed source term records retain canonical left/right orientation.
Repeated returned source records in query results are complete response evidence, not additional compiler work.

scope.mathematical_result: The displayed classical three product bases are exactly mutually unbiased after column normalization.
scope.generic_domain: At most dimension six, at most dimension+1 bases, twelfth-cyclotomic integer coordinates, positive integer column squared norms.
scope.original_problem: Construct at least four MUBs in dimension six, or prove that seven cannot exist.
scope.not_established: Neither original target, global maximality of three, classification of all MUBs, independent product-triple nonextension proof, current frontier, novelty or prize entitlement.
scope.unexercised_branches: Other dimensions/families, failed-comparison outcomes and unsupported norms were source-inspected only.
scope.publication: All source, proof and complete new arithmetic evidence are intended for the claimed Git paths.
